'''Bishop of war''' was a title used for the leader of the [[warrior monk]]s who protected the [[City/Legends|cities]] and villages on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The bishop of war was appointed by the [[High Priest of the Golden Sun]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Karak]] was the bishop of war until he broke away from the [[Priests of the Sun]] and led his own group of [[Karak's renegades|renegades]] in [[Sedri civil war|opposition]] to [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]].<ref name="BGS" />
